projects.title: Air Quality Monitoring & PM2.5 Prediction Using Deep Learning
highlights: Compared CNN, LSTM, and CNN-LSTM hybrid models for PM2.5 forecasting, achieving ~22% lower RMSE and R² up to 0.37 over baseline models.
Built end-to-end preprocessing pipeline — normalization, temporal lag features, rolling statistics — across 6,000+ time-series samples.
Performed comprehensive error analysis identifying systematic under-prediction at high pollution levels.

projects.title: Crop Maturity Stage Detection from Field Images
highlights: Built a crop maturity classification system using VGG-16, ResNet-50, and DenseNet-121 to identify Early, Mid, and Mature growth stages.
Designed end-to-end image pipeline with resizing, normalization, augmentation, and feature extraction for robust real-world performance.
Achieved 89.8% accuracy with VGG-16 on a dataset of 3,300+ agricultural images.

projects.title: Veriterra — Waste Traceability SaaS
projects.summary: Multi-tenant SaaS that traces hospital and hotel waste from generation to recycling, with a recycler portal.
highlights: Designing and building a multi-tenant waste traceability SaaS that traces hospital and hotel waste from generation to recycling, with a dedicated recycler portal for managing incoming pickups and issuing verifiable certificates.
Designed a multi-tenant data model with department-scoped access control, tracking every waste entry through a defined Pending → Collected → Processed → Certified lifecycle.

Containerized the stack with a multi-stage Dockerfile and deployed to AWS ECS (Fargate) behind an Application Load Balancer, provisioned through a dedicated least-privilege IAM user rather than root-level access.
Debugged a TypeScript monorepo build-output issue and stale-cache rendering bugs in production.
